newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 1,224,700 MT--a marketing-year high--were 54 percent greater than the previous week and 85 percent above the 4-week average. Major increases were reported for Japan (334,900 MT), unknown destinations (303,800 MT), Egypt (74,400 MT, includes 50,000 new sales, 24,900 destination changes, 500 cancellations), Guatemala (64,900 MT), Poland (50,800 MT), and Algeria (44,800 MT).

Exports of 1,385,800 MT--a marketing-year high--were 37 percent above the week earlier and 52 percent more than the 4-week average. Japan (433,800 MT) was the leading destination, followed South Korea (164,700 MT), Taiwan (113,400 MT), Poland (93,800 MT), Mexico (92,400 MT), Malaysia (60,400 MT), and the Philippines (55,000 MT).
